chapter: Leading a band: Beverly Gardens to Honeysuckle Inn
title: Hip Henley, Honeysuckle Inn and Eddie Miller leaving
summary: Ownership of the clubs, staying at the Honeysuckle Inn, and Eddie Miller leaving for Tony Almerico and Crosby.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Wasn't Hip Henley in partnership with Leon and Chalky down at the Hollywood Inn?
Yeah, after. After. After? No, no, before.
Because that's when I worked out there for the holiday.
That was on St. Claude Street when you worked at the...

That didn't work there, but I mean when Hip had the Two Bits Club... He used to come out there with the money that he collected from Prima and Chalky, which was used to get about $200 and he'd come up just to have about enough to pay the band off out there at the Hunnysuckle Inn.

We were working at the Hunnysuckle Inn. We were across the street because we stayed a couple of years at the 25 Cent Club, and then we went over to the Hunnysuckle Inn. That's when Eddie Miller left with Tony Almerico. And he said, I told him, I said, Eddie, I said, you can play as good as the rest of them guys up there. I said, you might have to sweat it out. Go ahead and sweat it out and go ahead up there. So he went over there and he... Remember he went up to Rose... What was the hell he called? Rose Garden or Rose... Roseland. Roseland up there and he played with several outfits over there and then he come along there with John and Crosby. Crosby started after that. So we stayed in business there until Bill got sick. Bill Padron? Bill Padron got sick and he went to the hospital. Is that when Bowman came on?
